description: Use ONLY after the human explicitly answers the currently surfaced imported-ADR question with approve or decline, in this conversation. Never infer approval from silence, continued work, an earlier generic sign-off, or the ADR file's own status. The source and review hashes bind the answer to the exact bytes and mapped meaning shown. Approve grants human-confirmed authority; decline records review but keeps the ADR advisory.

cwd.description: Your current directory, when it differs from where this session started (e.g. a worktree); writes then commit there, not to the original root.

expected_review_hash.description: Mapped-decision hash printed with the question; catches importer-semantic changes even when source bytes are unchanged.

reviewed_by.description: Credential-free reviewer label; defaults to human:interactive-chat for a direct answer in this chat.
